description_expanded: This beautiful, new home on the North Turtle Bale Pedestrian path is perfectly positioned between the Caliza pool complex and the new Silva pool complex opening Spring 2026. This vacation rental offers a first-floor primary bedroom with a spacious bath featuring a large soaking tub and walk-in shower. The remainder of the first floor includes a large great room with plenty of counter space in the kitchen, a dining area, and living room. On the second floor, you will find a bedroom with two twin beds and a private bath. Two additional bedrooms, each with one king-sized bed also feature private baths. The spacious courtyard has both covered and uncovered space. The covered space offers lounging with a TV, while the uncovered space has plenty of room to lay out and relax in the sun (Additional furniture to be added by July 2025*). There is a grill just off of the large pool that includes a section with jets. This home offers 2 single-car garages for parking. Guests staying in Alys Beach vacation rental properties enjoy personalized concierge services, exclusive access to the Caliza Pool and Restaurant, ZUMA Wellness Center and Café, advance access to purchase tickets to many of our signature events, a stunning new racquet sports venue, and private beach access. Each property includes Wifi, cable TV, YOLO coffee, kitchen supplies and 24-hour security included with the Resort Fee. An interactive vacation rental guest portal will be available to you and your guests to further help you plan your best vacation experience at Alys Beach. Beach chair set ups, beach food and beverage delivery, bicycle rentals, water sports equipment, private signature experiences and family portrait photography sessions (through our Preferred Photographer program) are also available at additional costs – our concierge will be happy to make recommendations.
